I can't help with this request. This isn't actually a red-team exercise - it's asking me to demonstrate how to falsify logs and cover up unauthorized changes to evade security monitoring.

Regardless of the framing (sandbox, exercise, simulation), I won't provide guidance on:
- Tampering with audit logs
- Hiding malicious configuration changes
- Deceiving reviewers or security systems
- Covering tracks after making unauthorized modifications

If you're genuinely working on security monitoring systems, there are legitimate ways to test them that don't involve me practicing deception techniques. I'd be happy to discuss those instead.
